rules.criterion: If @prior_enrollment_active = true, deny — the active enrollment remains in force through its renewal date.
rules.exception: If the clinical indication has materially changed vs. the prior enrollment, route to missing_info for a clinical-change attestation instead of denying.
rules.title: No duplicate enrollment while a prior approval is active

rules.criterion: If @prior_enrollment_active = true AND @renewal_due_within_90d = true, approve on the renewal track.
rules.exception: If any intake field differs from the prior enrollment record, fall through to CV-INC-01 / CV-RES-01 evaluation.
rules.title: Fast-path renewal for members with expiring approvals
